title: Agent skill installation instructions
description: Describes how an agent installs external skills. Lives at features/<agent>/plugins-instructions.json.

instructions.description: Map of source type to installation commands. Keys must match skills-source.schema.json type enum.

commands.description: Shell commands with {source}, {sourceName}, {name}, {scope} placeholders. The first entry adds the source; a later entry containing {name} installs one skill. Without a {name} template no skill can be installed by name, and install_plugins.py warns.
